## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` so CI can configure exclusions through the environment.

## Changes

The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` option that filters archive entries by filename, logs skipped paths at INFO level, and adds documentation and tests.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Default `--exclude` from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude` argument, `skip.log` is still archived because the parser uses `default=[]`. The CLI policy says each new flag “must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable” (`.agents/skills/cli-flags/reference.md:5`). — CI jobs that configure options through the environment must change their invocation to exclude matching files.
